display.purpose: Large page headings, only where layout supports the scale.

components.name: Primary Button (provisional)
components.css: .ds-primary-button { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface); border: 0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 600 16px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button (provisional)
components.description: Lower-priority action, using the deep navy palette.
components.css: .ds-secondary-button { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 600 16px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-secondary-button:hover { background: var(--color-primary-light); } .ds-secondary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input (provisional)
components.description: Neutral text field with an accent focus indicator.
components.css: .ds-text-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px var(--font-sans); } .ds-text-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-text-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-secondary); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Card (provisional)
components.description: Neutral content grouping; no shadow convention established yet.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card p { margin-bottom: 0; color: var(--color-secondary); }

narrative.northStar: Loopr AI — confident clarity for a modern product.
narrative.overview: Loopr AI is the user-selected visual north star. Preserve the observed blue-led palette and Outfit typography while keeping the interface crisp, legible, and focused on the work. This is a visual reference, not a request to copy Loopr's page layouts or product content. The app is still a TanStack starter; component patterns remain provisional until the product UI exists.
keyCharacteristics: Outfit typography with restrained neutral surfaces.
Clear semantic color roles; reuse tokens instead of raw values.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use primary, secondary, accent, and surface tokens by role; do not scatter literal color values through components.

dos: Use existing Tailwind utilities such as bg-primary, text-secondary, and font-sans.
Keep text and interactive states legible against their surfaces.
Preserve Loopr AI as visual inspiration without copying page composition or content.
donts: Hard-code palette values in components when a theme utility exists.
Present provisional component or radius choices as established project conventions.
Add a competing font or accent palette without a clear product need.
